hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
cd /var/www/html/eol_php8_code/update_resources/connectors # source is: archive.zip --- https://zenodo.org/records/13316357 # renamed to: Smith_et_al_2011.tar.gz
#OK 0: case where lifeStage is a col in MoF => move to a col in occurrence. php resource_utility.php _ '{"resource_id": "Smith_et_al_2011_meta_recoded", "task": "metadata_recoding"}' # source: [Smith_et_al_2011.tar.gz] hard-coded input in resource_utility.php # generates: Smith_et_al_2011_meta_recoded.tar.gz.tar.gz cd /var/www/html/eol_php8_code/applications/content_server/resources cp Smith_et_al_2011_meta_recoded.tar.gz Smith_etal_2011.tar.gz cd /var/www/html/eol_php8_code/update_resources/connectors
#OK 1: This will add higherClassification in taxon.tab and rebuild the DwCA. With carry-over of other extensions. php dwca_utility.php _ '{"resource_id": "Smith_etal_2011", "task": "gen_hC_using_pID"}'
#OK 2: This use gnparser one name at a time. Not entire file. php run_gnparser_dwca.php _ '{"resource_id": "Smith_etal_2011-with-hC"}' #OK gen neo4j_1
#OK 3: Start matching taxa php match_taxa_2DH.php _ '{"resource_id": "Smith_etal_2011-with-hC_neo4j_1", "AncestryIndexVer": "new"}' #OK gen +_eolID
#OK 4: Convert taxon.tab, use EOLid value for taxonID. # REMINDER: Multiple scinames with different taxonIDs have the same canonical thus will have the same EOLid php use_EOLid_as_taxonID.php _ '{"resource_id": "Smith_etal_2011-with-hC_neo4j_1_eolID"}' # gen Smith_et_al_2011_finale
php analyze_MoF.php _ '{"resource_id": "Smith_etal_2011_finale"}' #gen Smith_et_al_2011_finale_analyzed
# rename cd /var/www/html/eol_php8_code/applications/content_server/resources cp Smith_etal_2011_finale_analyzed.tar.gz Smith_etal_2011_TraitBank_1_0.tar.gz ls -lt Smith_etal_2011_finale_analyzed.tar.gz ls -lt Smith_etal_2011_TraitBank_1_0.tar.gz rm -f Smith_etal_2011_finale_analyzed.tar.gz
